notes: SCOPE/SOURCES: Q1/21-Q4/23 and FY2021-FY2023; IS, seg, ops, adj_oi, adj_ni only (no bs/cf). Per the latest-filing rule every quarter is taken from the prior-year column of the following year's Q-release (Q1/21 from Q1/22 release, ..., Q4/23 and FY2023 from the Q4/24 release filed 22-Jan-2025, FY2021 from Q4/22 release, FY2022 from Q4/23 release); the period's own release and the 10-K are also cited in src. Product lines, US-Government sales and basic EPS/shares come from 10-Qs/10-Ks (XBRL companyfacts). All 2023 values shown in 2024 releases are identical to the 2023 releases (only labels changed, see below); all 2022 values shown in 2023 releases are identical to 2022 releases except where noted.

NON-GAAP DEFINITION EVOLUTION (1) Q1/21 release (28-Apr-2021, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428521000085/q1-2021earningsrelease.htm): measures were called 'adjusted' and excluded ONLY charges related to the pending FLIR acquisition: 'Transaction costs' $5.9m (corporate SG&A; NI effect 4.6, $0.12) and 'Debt issue costs and interest expense' $33.1m (17.2 bridge-facility fees/interest + 13.4 debt-extinguishment on $493.3m notes called 17-Mar-21 + 2.5 interest on the $3.0bn FLIR notes; NI 25.6, $0.67). Acquired-intangible amortization was NOT excluded. Originally published Q1/21: adjusted OI 141.1 (17.5% margin), adjusted NI 114.9, adjusted EPS 3.02; tax effect at the overall estimated effective rate ex discrete items.

NON-GAAP DEFINITION EVOLUTION (2) Q2/21 release (28-Jul-2021, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428521000122/q2-2021earningsrelease.htm), first release after the FLIR close (14-May-2021): renamed 'non-GAAP'; from this release ALL acquired intangible asset amortization (FLIR and all prior acquisitions) is excluded, plus FLIR inventory step-up, FLIR transaction and integration costs (incl. $52.2m cash settlement of FLIR employee/director stock awards in Q2/21), bridge loan and debt extinguishment fees and the remeasurement of deferred taxes on acquired intangibles for tax-law changes ('Tax rate changes on acquired intangible assets', UK rate rise to 25%: +12.4 in Q2/21). Acquired intangible amortization was simultaneously moved out of SG&A to its own income-statement line (prior periods reclassified). Q1/21 and all 2020 quarters were recast (Appendix A and a revised Q1/21 table): Q1/21 restated to non-GAAP OI 150.9 (18.7%), non-GAAP NI 121.3, EPS 3.19 - the LATER figures are recorded here. In the recast, Q1/21 financing exclusion became 'Bridge loan and debt extinguishment fees' 30.6 (the 2.5 interest on the permanent notes is no longer excluded) and transaction-cost tax effect became 5.8 NI (was 4.6). Tax effects from Q2/21 are item-by-item at jurisdictional rates (US marginal rate for most amortization).

NON-GAAP DEFINITION EVOLUTION (3) Q3/21 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428521000167/q3-2021earningsrelease.htm): new NI item 'Acquisition-related foreign tax matters' = post-acquisition interest on certain FLIR income-tax reserves PLUS the UK deferred-tax remeasurement previously labelled 'Tax rate changes on acquired intangible assets' (9M/21 14.1 = Q2 12.4 + Q3 1.7). (4) Q4/21 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428522000008/q4-2021earningsrelease.htm): renamed 'Acquisition-related tax matters' and widened to include tax benefits/costs from settlement or resolution of FLIR tax reserves (Q4/21 -21.4; FY21 -7.3). FY2022 outlook (Q4/21 release) excludes only acquired intangible amortization 'for all acquisitions' (FLIR deal costs ended). (5) Q4/22 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428523000004/q4-2022earningsrelease.htm): 'FLIR transaction and integration costs' of -4.0 (pre-tax income from favourable resolution of certain FLIR integration-related costs). (6) Q1/23 release: definition text trimmed to 'certain FLIR acquisition integration-related costs, acquired intangible asset amortization' and tax matters; inventory step-up and bridge fees no longer referenced. (7) Q2/23 outlook / Q3/23 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428523000122/q3-2023earningsrelease.htm): new 'FLIR integration costs' (facility consolidation/relocation of Teledyne FLIR operations) 5.8 in Q3/23, 3.0 in Q4/23. (8) Label changes only: Q2/24 release onward 'FLIR acquisition-related tax matters' (used here for Q2/23-Q4/23 and FY2023); Q4/24 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428525000003/q4-2024earningsrelease.htm) relabels the Q4/23 and FY2023 FLIR integration costs as 'Transaction and integration costs' (used here for Q4/23 and FY2023); Q3/22 and Q4/22/FY2022 columns in the 2023 releases relabel the Q4/22 -4.0 'FLIR transaction and integration costs' as 'FLIR integration costs'. Amounts unchanged in all relabelings.

ADJ_NI STRUCTURE: Teledyne's NI reconciliation shows each item in three columns (Income before income taxes / Net income / Diluted EPS) and NO separate tax line. For each pre-tax item 'value' = pre-tax amount, 'value_ni' = after-tax amount added to net income, 'value_eps' = per-share; a derived TAX item = sum(value_ni - value) over pre-tax items makes items sum exactly to adj_ni_published - ni_gaap. Tax-only items (acquisition-related tax matters, TAXD) have no pre-tax amount: value = NI-column amount. Items shown as '-' in a period are omitted. adj_pretax_published = company's non-GAAP income before income taxes. Base: 'Net income' through Q2/21 presentations, 'Net income attributable to Teledyne' from Q3/22 onward (NCI immaterial; none in 2021).

ADJ_OI / SEGMENTS: adj_oi from the consolidated GAAP OI -> non-GAAP OI table; adj_om_published is the company's stated margin (fraction). Segment non-GAAP from Appendix A tables: amort_<seg> = segment acquired intangible amortization; adj_oi_<seg> = segment non-GAAP OI; adj_corp = non-GAAP corporate expense shown as a POSITIVE expense (same sign convention as corp_exp; company shows it negative); seg_items = segment inventory step-up and transaction/integration costs (seg 'corp' = corporate). Check: sum(adj_oi_<seg>) - adj_corp = adj_oi_published, and oi_<seg> + amort_<seg> + seg_items = adj_oi_<seg>, hold for every period. FLIR is in Digital Imaging; the 2021 'transaction' costs in corporate (77.1 FY21) include the $52.2m FLIR stock-award settlement (Q2/21).

IS PRESENTATION: Acquired intangible asset amortization is a separate IS line from the Q2/21 release (Q1/21 reclassified out of SG&A in the Q1/22 release: SG&A 168.2 vs 178.0 originally). It is recorded as other_op = -amortization (label 'Acquired intangible asset amortization') so that net_sales - cost_sales - sga + other_op = op_income; the same amount is in memo amort_intangibles. sga includes company R&D as presented.

IS PRESENTATION: 'Gain (loss) on debt extinguishment' became a separate non-operating line in the Q2/22 release (prior periods reclassified out of interest and debt expense). It is recorded under extra key gain_debt_ext (signed, gain +). Q1/21: the Q1/22 release still shows interest and debt expense of 35.7 for Q1/21; using the reclassified 6M/21 and FY2021 presentation (interest 43.5 = Q1 22.3 + Q2 21.2; loss on extinguishment 13.4, all in Q1) Q1/21 is recorded as interest_exp_net 22.3 and gain_debt_ext -13.4 (sum unchanged at 35.7). The 13.4 relates to the $493.3m notes called 17-Mar-2021. Q2/22: +10.6 gain on repurchase of $75.0m 2030/2031 notes; Q2/23: +1.6 gain on $10.0m 2031 notes. pretax = op_income - interest_exp_net + gain_debt_ext + non_service_pension + other_income holds for all periods.

IS: NCI line first presented in the Q3/22 release (NL Acoustics 80% interest acquired 15-Jul-2022); 2021 Q3/Q4/FY and Q1/22-Q2/22 shown as '-' in later releases (recorded 0); Q1/21, Q2/21 latest presentations have no NCI line (omitted). Q2/21 base for adj_ni is 'Net income'. Tax: Q1/22 benefit (9.6) and Q4/23 benefit (69.3) recorded as negative tax. discrete_tax_benefit (extra key) = net discrete income tax benefit (+) / expense (-) stated in releases (Q1/22 includes 50.0 FLIR tax-reserve resolution; Q4/23 123.4 mainly resolution of historical acquisition-related tax positions, of which 102.2 treated as acquisition-related tax matter).

IS MEMO - basic shares/EPS: Q1-Q3 and FY from XBRL (10-Q/10-K, us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic, EarningsPerShareBasic); Q4 basic is not reported separately and is omitted (implied Q4 basic shares ~46.8 (2021), ~46.8 (2022), ~47.1 (2023)). Diluted shares/EPS from releases. Share count jumped in 2021 after 9.5m TDY shares were issued to FLIR holders on 14-May-2021.

IS MEMO - D&A: 'da' = depreciation and amortization as on the cash-flow statement/10-K (FY2021 371.8; 10-K footnote: includes $106.4m FLIR inventory step-up in Digital Imaging). Quarterly 2021 da derived from 10-Q YTD XBRL (6M 112.4, 9M 237.8): Q2 83.1, Q3 125.4, Q4 134.0 (= Q4/21 release figure, which included 47.8 step-up). Releases for Q2/21 and Q3/21 quoted D&A EXCLUDING step-up (59.7, 90.2) and the Q4/22 release restated Q4/21 D&A to 86.2 ex step-up; these are in extra key da_ex_stepup (FY21 265.4 = 115.2 depreciation + 149.3 intangible amortization + 0.9 other). 2022/2023 quarterly D&A from releases sum to the 10-K totals (332.2, 316.4). depreciation (FY only) from XBRL us-gaap:Depreciation.

IS MEMO - SBC: FY from 10-K cash-flow statement (33.9 / 31.5 / 32.3). 2021 quarters from 10-Q equity statement XBRL (StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensationGross: 7.0, 8.4, 8.7; Q4 = 33.9 - 24.1 = 9.8 derived). 2021 releases gave only stock option expense (4.2, 3.6, 5.8, 6.4 = 20.0) plus FLIR RSU expense in Digital Imaging (Q2 4.4, Q3 1.8, Q4 1.5; FY 7.8). 2022 quarters from 'stock-based compensation expense' comparatives in 2023 releases (9.0, 6.4, 6.7, 11.4) - these sum to 33.5 vs 10-K CF 31.5; XBRL equity-statement quarterly values are 7.0, 6.5, 6.6 (Q4 implied 11.4), i.e. the difference sits in Q1/22. 2023 quarters (7.9, 8.4, 8.0, 8.0) sum to 32.3 = CF.

IS MEMO - R&D: rd_company = 'research and development expense' per FY2024 10-K XBRL (2022 352.2, 2023 356.3; not given for 2021). rd_bp_company (extra) = company-funded R&D plus bid & proposal costs per FY2021-FY2023 10-K policy note (2021 299.3 incl. 113.8 FLIR partial year; 2022 360.6; 2023 365.8).

SEGMENTS: four segments (Digital Imaging, Instrumentation, Aerospace & Defense Electronics, Engineered Systems); releases list Digital Imaging first from Q2/21. No other reconciling line between segment OI and consolidated OI besides corporate expense. Product lines (Instrumentation only; exact labels 'Marine Instrumentation', 'Environmental Instrumentation', 'Test and Measurement Instrumentation') from 10-Q revenue notes and 10-K segment note; Q4 = FY - 9M (derived). A&DE (aerospace electronics / defense electronics) and Engineered Systems (engineered products / energy systems / turbine engines) product-line LEVELS are not disclosed - releases give only y/y changes (e.g. Q1/21 A&DE aerospace -10.7, defense +5.6). Teledyne exited the (cruise missile) turbine engine business in Q1/21. Annual seg da_/capex_/assets_ and sales_us_gov_<seg> from FY2023 10-K segment note (same values in FY2021/22 10-Ks; FY2021 D&A DI 309.2 includes 106.4 step-up).

OPS - acq_sales: 2021 and Q1/22-Q2/22 = incremental net sales from the FLIR acquisition (FLIR acquired 14-May-2021; Q2/22 167.6 reflects only the pre-anniversary portion). Q3/22, Q4/22 not stated. FY2022 593.7 'current and prior year acquisitions' (FLIR + NL Acoustics (Jul-22) + ETM-Electromatic (28-Oct-22)). 2023 quarters are Digital Imaging segment 'incremental sales from recent acquisitions' (ETM, ChartWorld (3-Jan-23), etc.; Q1 25.0, Q2 28.8, Q3 25.8, Q4 17.6 = 97.2); FY2023 99.8 is the company total (balance ~2.6 likely Xena Networks, Instrumentation, acquired 13-Oct-2023).

OPS - cash/leverage: cfo_published, capex_published, fcf_published (FCF = CFO - capex) and fcf_adj_published (adjusted FCF: adds back FLIR transaction cash payments net of tax in 2021, and the $296.4m Swedish Tax Authority payment for a pre-acquisition 2018 FLIR reassessment in Q1/22/FY22) from release tables. total_debt_published / net_debt_published = company non-GAAP total debt / net debt at period end (FY key = year end). leverage_published = 'Consolidated Leverage Ratio' (credit-agreement basis) as stated: Q2/21 3.7x (from Q3/21 release: 'declined to 3.3x from 3.7x at the end of the second quarter'; Q4/21 release also cites 3.8x in May 2021); Q3/22 not stated; Q2/23 2.1x is stated 'including continued debt repayment through July'; Q3/23 stated only as 'slightly below 2.0x' (omitted).

OPS - other: sales_us_gov = sales to US Government incl. as subcontractor (10-Q / 10-K customer-type table; Q4 = FY - 9M derived). rev_us/rev_europe/rev_asia/rev_other = net sales by geographic region of customer destination per the FY2023 10-K (FY2021 10-K originally presented sales by country of origin: US 2,932.1, Canada 458.1, UK 286.3, Belgium 227.3, Netherlands 127.0, other 583.5). orders: only Q4/23 'all-time record orders of $1,519.4 million' stated (Q1/24 release: Q1/24 orders 1,433.2 up 7.8% y/y, so Q1/23 not stated in $). book_to_bill_published Q2/22 1.08x, Q3/22 1.06x. Funded backlog not disclosed in this era; Q2/22 release says 'over $3.0 billion of backlog'; rpo = remaining performance obligations at fiscal year end from 10-K revenue note (2,929.0 / 3,099.3 / 3,141.7; ~76-78% within 12 months). employees = approximate total workforce from 10-K Item 1.

CHECKS (validate.py): IS arithmetic ties for all 15 periods; quarterly sums = FY for every IS, segment, amortization, non-GAAP OI and NI item within 0.1 rounding except (a) per-share figures (adj EPS quarters sum 16.70 vs FY 16.86 in 2021 because of the May-2021 share issuance; 2022 18.18 vs 18.19; 2023 19.69 vs 19.69; GAAP EPS 9.91 vs 10.05 in 2021), (b) 2022 SBC (33.5 vs 31.5, see SBC note), (c) 2023 acq_sales (quarters are DI-only, 97.2 vs company total 99.8), (d) 2023 sales_us_gov: Q4/23 = FY 1,381.7 - reported 9M 989.3 = 392.4, but reported Q1+Q2+Q3 = 979.1 because the 10-Q 9M A&DE US-Gov figure (205.9) exceeds the sum of its quarters (64.7+61.0+69.8 = 195.5) - company inconsistency (repeated unchanged in the Q3/24 10-Q), so 2023 quarters sum to 1,371.5; every reconciliation ties (oi_gaap + items = adj_oi_published; ni_gaap + items = adj_ni_published; segment sums = consolidated). Revenue, operating income, net income, diluted EPS, amortization and capex agree with XBRL companyfacts (Q4 = FY - 9M).

OTHER: FY2021 52 weeks (Q4/21 13 weeks; Q4/20 was 14 weeks). FLIR consideration ~$8.1bn (9.5m TDY shares + $3.7bn cash). FY2021 FLIR-related pre-tax charges 350.3 (110.3 FLIR intangible amortization, 106.4 step-up, 103.0 transaction/integration, 30.6 bridge/extinguishment) plus 39.0 amortization from prior acquisitions = 389.3 total specified items. Swedish tax matter: SEK 2.8bn ($303.0m) liability affirmed 26-Jan-2022; $296.4m paid Q1/22 (in CFO; added back in adjusted FCF).
